title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Ten documented GW rituals spanning arrival, service, seasonal celebrations, academic milestones, school spirit and graduation in Washington, D.C.

cards.title: Start the Year at First Night
cards.subtitle: GW’s post-move-in welcome on University Yard
cards.notes: Head to University Yard after move-in for GW’s opening celebration; expect organized activities, food and a movie alongside new and returning students.
cards.short_summary: The academic year opens with a large outdoor welcome gathering after students move in.
cards.evidence_claim: GW’s official traditions page says First Night welcomes new and returning students after move-in with activities, food and a movie on University Yard.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled around the start of the academic year; consult GW’s events calendar for the current date and participation details.

cards.entity_name: GW Convocation and Day of Service
cards.title: Enter GW Through Service
cards.subtitle: A class welcome paired with work across Washington
cards.notes: Watch for class-year instructions, then join the assigned service project; GW cites activities such as planting gardens and repainting schools.
cards.short_summary: GW formally welcomes a new class and sends students into Washington for organized community service.
cards.evidence_claim: GW’s official traditions page documents Convocation and Day of Service as an official welcome in which the entire class gives back across Washington, D.C.
cards.access_notes: Participation logistics and project assignments are issued by GW; follow current university instructions before attending.

cards.title: Carve Into Fall at the Vern
cards.subtitle: Mount Vernon Campus Quad’s annual autumn gathering
cards.notes: Travel to the Mount Vernon Campus Quad for the annual gathering and choose among pumpkin carving, crafts, yard games, contests and music.
cards.short_summary: GW’s Mount Vernon community marks fall with a family-friendly quad celebration.
cards.evidence_claim: GW identifies Vern Harvest as an annual fall event on the Mount Vernon Campus Quad featuring pumpkin carving, crafts, yard games, friendly contests and music.
cards.access_notes: Held in the fall on the Mount Vernon Campus Quad; verify the annual event date and transportation information with GW.

cards.title: Observe GW’s Veterans Day Wreath Laying
cards.subtitle: A university remembrance led with GW Veterans
cards.notes: Attend respectfully and follow the ceremony’s current guidance while GW Veterans and university leaders recognize past, present and future veterans.
cards.short_summary: GW marks Veterans Day with a formal wreath-laying ceremony involving veterans and university leadership.
cards.evidence_claim: GW’s official traditions page documents a Veterans Day Wreath Laying led by GW Veterans and members of the university administration.
cards.access_notes: A commemorative event associated with Veterans Day; consult GW’s calendar for the current ceremony location and protocol.

cards.title: Pause Finals for Midnight Breakfast
cards.subtitle: GW’s annual late-semester study break
cards.notes: Check the finals-period announcement, then step away from studying for food and activities served or hosted by GW faculty and staff volunteers.
cards.short_summary: Students interrupt finals preparation for a late-night meal and activities with university employees.
cards.evidence_claim: GW describes Midnight Breakfast as an annual finals study-break tradition with food, activities and faculty and staff volunteers.
cards.access_notes: Held during the final-exam period; verify the current date, venue, eligibility and entry requirements in GW announcements.

cards.entity_name: GW Commencement on the National Mall
cards.title: Graduate on the National Mall
cards.subtitle: GW’s university-wide ceremony among Washington landmarks
cards.notes: Use the current commencement site map and entry guidance, then celebrate with the Washington Monument and other national landmarks as the backdrop.
cards.short_summary: GW’s graduating class assembles on the National Mall for the university-wide commencement ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: GW’s traditions page documents University Commencement on the National Mall, where graduates celebrate against Washington’s landmarks and monuments.
cards.access_notes: For graduates and their guests during Commencement Week; current credentials, entrances and accessibility guidance may apply.

cards.title: End the Ceremony With the Fight Song
cards.subtitle: The traditional close to GW academic ceremonies
cards.notes: Stand if able when the ceremony closes, then join students, faculty, staff, alumni, families and guests in singing the GW Fight Song and Alma Mater.
cards.short_summary: Academic ceremonies conclude communally with GW’s two institutional songs.
cards.evidence_claim: GW’s commencement traditions page says academic ceremonies traditionally end with the Fight Song and Alma Mater and invites attendees to stand if able and sing along.
cards.access_notes: Occurs at GW academic ceremonies; standing is expressly framed as optional for those who are able.

cards.title: Make Your Mark at Chalk-In
cards.subtitle: A long-running creative tradition in Potomac Square
cards.notes: Bring your creativity to Potomac Square for music, crafts and a finals-season reset; check the Buff & Bloom schedule for rain-location details.
cards.short_summary: GW students gather for a long-running, hands-on creative break before finals.
cards.evidence_claim: GW’s 2026 Buff & Bloom coverage identifies Chalk-In as a long-standing GW tradition and specifies that the 2026 edition was the 45th annual event.
cards.source_title: GW Expands Buff & Bloom Week with Philanthropic Focus
cards.access_notes: An annual spring event associated with Buff & Bloom Week; consult the current schedule because timing and rain location can change.

cards.title: Celebrate the Academic Midpoint
cards.subtitle: GW’s class-year marker halfway to a degree
cards.notes: Look for your class-year invitation when you reach the midpoint of college, then join classmates for GW’s dedicated milestone celebration.
cards.short_summary: Sophomores receive a GW celebration devoted to reaching the midpoint of their undergraduate journey.
cards.evidence_claim: GW’s Division for Student Affairs calls Halfway to Graduation a GW tradition marking the midpoint of the college experience.
cards.source_title: Buff and Bloom Week | Division for Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: A class-year program; eligibility, date and venue vary by cohort and should be confirmed through current GW communications.

cards.title: Welcome Spring With Buff & Bloom
cards.subtitle: GW traditions timed to Washington’s blossom season
cards.notes: Review the annual schedule and choose student-driven events that fit your interests; programming changes while retaining the spring celebration.
cards.short_summary: Cherry-blossom season becomes a week of student-organized GW activities and community programming.
cards.evidence_claim: GW describes Buff & Bloom Week as its annual spring celebration, featuring student-driven events, giveaways and traditions inspired by cherry-blossom season.
cards.source_title: Buff and Bloom Week | Division for Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Annual spring programming changes by year; consult the Division for Student Affairs schedule for event-specific access or ticket requirements.
